name: ETL Azure Blob Storage to Redshift
steps:
1.  From the DataSources section select **Azure Blob Storage** as the data source.
2.  Select your added Redshift data warehouse as the data destination. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [Data Warehouse](https://console.datachannel.co/datawarehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
3.  Authorize DataChannel to connect to your **Azure Blob Storage** account using the **(+)** icon with your **Storage Account Name, Account Key** & **Endpoint Suffix****.** Read more about how to find these details [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/applications/cloud_storage/azure-blob-storage/setup.html).
4.  Click on [+ Data Pipeline](https://console.datachannel.co/datasource/azure-blob-storage/report/new) to start adding data pipelines to your account.
